spans.s:
CAN, only aor. caniṣṭám and cániṣṭat, rejoice in (lc.);
 gladden.

cán-as, n. gladness: only with dhā, 🞄rejoice in (ac., lc.);
 grant.
c-āna-ś, the pt. suffix -āna.

canas-yá, den. P. rejoice in (ac.): 🞄pp. canasita, welcome! (voc.);
 gentle — (with 🞄N. of Brahman, or, according to some, with 🞄that of a Kṣatriya or Vaiśya).
cán-iṣṭha, spv. very welcome, very 🞄gracious.
CAND, v. श्वन्द् ŚCAND, shine.
cāndana, a. (ī) made of sandal-wood.
candanā-ya, den. Ā. become a sandal 🞄tree.
candana‿udaka, n. fluid essence 🞄of sandal wood.
canda-lā, f. N. of a woman.
candrak-ita, pp. marked with 🞄moon-shaped spots.

candr-ikā, f. moonlight;
 N..
candr-ín, a. golden.

candra‿udaya m. rise of the moon;
 🞄-upala, m. moon-stone (v. candra-kānta).

cāndra‿ayaṇa, m. observer of the 🞄moonʼs course;
 n. moon-course penance in 🞄which the number of mouthfuls eaten decreases 🞄by one daily from fifteen at full moon 🞄to none at new moon, after which it increases 🞄similarly (it may begin either at new or at full 🞄moon): -vrata, n. id..
